description: A stereo router that sends one input pair to one of eight output pairs, stepped by a trigger or addressed by a voltage

params.text: Chooses whether the TRG/CV jack is read as triggers that step from one output to the next, or as a voltage that addresses an output directly
Sets how many of the eight outputs the cycle runs through, 1 to 8
Sets which way the selection moves on each trigger: down the column, at random, or up the column
Sets how long the crossfade between one output and the next takes, 1ms to 10 seconds; fully anticlockwise the change is instant
Sets which output a reset jumps to, 1 to 8; it can be outside the range the OUTs selector cycles through

inputs.text: Steps or addresses the selection, depending on the TRG/CV switch: a trigger to step, or 0-10V spread across the outputs the OUTs selector covers
A trigger here jumps to the output the RST knob sets
The left channel of the signal being routed
The right channel of the signal being routed; with nothing patched the left jack is used for both

outputs.text: The left channel of one of the eight destinations; it carries the signal only while it is the selected one
The right channel of one of the eight destinations; it carries the signal only while it is the selected one

menu: Cycle — with this unticked the selection stops at the last output instead of wrapping round to the first
RST input = reverse advance — turns the RST jack into a backward step instead of a jump to the RST knob's output; with the direction set to random it gives a random output either way
Initialize on Start — starts from the output the RST knob sets when Rack loads a patch, instead of resuming where it left off

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the jack to its left.
